The '''Sunrace Citadel''' was located in a prosperous region along the equator of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Weik/Legends|Weik]]. Connected to the populated regions of [[Vossport/Legends|Vossport]] and [[Fume/Legends|Fume]] by a long road that ran through the [[Madlands]], the Citadel was geographically close to the [[Highland Lakes]] region.<ref name="NoP" />
